newsitem.title: NORWAY: FORECAST - Uncertainty over Kvaerner result.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Uncertainty over Kvaerner result.

text.p: Norwegian construction and engineering group Kvaerner ASA is expected to book profits before tax of 952 million crowns for the full-year 1996, according to a Reuter poll of 12 Norwegian and international analysts.
For the first nine months of the year Kvaerner posted pre-tax profits of 851 million crowns. Analysts therefore expect the fourth quarter isolated to yield 101 million crowns.
Comparative figures for the year ago period are not available due to Kvaerner's takeover of British-based conglomerate Trafalgar House Plc in April.
Recommendations were mixed -- five said buy, four said hold, two said sell and one declined to give a view -- reflecting the uncertainty surrounding the company and its results.
"It's like looking for a needle in a haystack. Many strange things can happen (with Kvaerner)," said a London-based analyst.
Another said: "Since I have followed them, Kvaerner has yet to make positive surprises with their results."
The analysts said the uncertainty was linked with the company's balance sheet, cashflow, asset sales, provisions and whether it had halted the losses in its pulping division.
"The numbers are important, but one must focus on the underlying earnings potential," said an analyst with particular interest in the trend in former Trafalgar House units.
